name: Jackalope “Many agents. One workspace.” OG social card by Jackalope
description: A 1200×630 social card split into a light brand half and a dark product half on a warm off-white field. Nine outlined rabbit silhouettes shift hue from orange through violet to blue before resolving into one solid black jackalope — a literal “many → one” story — while thin orange and blue circuit traces with node dots thread across the canvas. The two-line statement (“Many agents.” in ink, “One workspace.” in orange) anchors the bottom-left above a monospace domain, and a dark tasks-board screenshot, tilted a few degrees and bleeding off the right and bottom edges, supplies the dense UI contrast that makes the flat left half read instantly at feed size.
